import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int K, sum, current, a[] = new int[110];

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] v = new int[35][35];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < v[0].length; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix result = new Matrix();
            for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                    if (v[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                            if (b.v[k][j] != 0) {
                                long temp = (1L * v[i][k] * b.v[k][j]) % MOD;
                                result.v[i][j] = (int) ((result.v[i][j] + temp) % MOD);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static void add_mod(int[] arr, int y, int m) {
        arr[0] += y;
        if (arr[0] >= m) arr[0] -= m;
    }

    static void process_number(long number) {
        int m = 0;
        while (number != 0) {
            a[++m] = (int) (number % K);
            number /= K;
        }
        // reverse a[1..m]
        for (int i = 1; i <= m / 2; i++) {
            int temp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[m - i + 1];
            a[m - i + 1] = temp;
        }
        // store m for further use
        // but in Java, we need to pass m as parameter or store globally
        // so we can store m in a static variable
        processNumberLength = m;
    }

    static int processNumberLength;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        process_number(n);
        int m = processNumberLength;

        Matrix[][] s = new Matrix[m + 1][K + 1];
        Matrix[][] prefix = new Matrix[m + 1][K + 1];
        Matrix[][] suffix = new Matrix[m + 1][K + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                s[i][j] = new Matrix();
                prefix[i][j] = new Matrix();
                suffix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        // Initialize s[0][i]
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                s[0][i].v[j][j] = 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                s[0][i].v[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int idx = i - 1;
            // Build prefix and suffix matrices
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                prefix[idx][j] = s[idx][j];
                suffix[idx][j] = s[idx][j];
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                prefix[idx][j] = prefix[idx][j - 1].multiply(s[idx][j]);
            }
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suffix[idx][j] = s[idx][j].multiply(suffix[idx][j + 1]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                if (j != 0) {
                    s[i][j] = suffix[idx][j].multiply(prefix[idx][j - 1]);
                } else {
                    s[i][j] = suffix[idx][j];
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize answer matrix
        Matrix answer = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            answer.v[i][i] = 1;
        }

        current = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int ai = a[i];
            if (ai != 0) {
                if (current + ai - 1 >= K) {
                    for (int j = current; j < K; j++) {
                        answer = answer.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j <= (current + ai - 1) - K; j++) {
                        answer = answer.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int j = current; j <= current + ai - 1; j++) {
                        answer = answer.multiply(s[m - i][j]);
                    }
                }
                add_mod(new int[]{current}, ai, K);
            }
        }

        sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            add_mod(new int[]{sum}, answer.v[i][K], MOD);
        }

        System.out.println(sum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
